Initial release of work-productivity-proactive-agent-workflow-helper.

- Provides practical support for Agent users seeking Proactive Agent-style workflows on Clawhub.
- Offers help with bug fixing, setup hardening, safety, reliability, and creation of related skills.
- Workflow includes restating user goals, generating concise plans or checklists, validating outputs, and highlighting next steps.
- Focuses on proven demand, usability, and producing actionable, hardware-friendly results.
- Activates on relevant work-productivity and agent-related keywords and requests.
